title: Benchmarking Sensor-Fault Robustness in Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2605.10822v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Cyber-physical system (CPS) forecasting models depend on sensor streams with noisy, biased, missing, or temporally misaligned readings, yet standard forecasting evaluation often selects models by nominal error without showing whether they remain robust under such faults. We introduce SensorFault-Bench, a CPS-grounded protocol that evaluates forecasting architectures and robustness-improvement methods through controlled synthetic stress tests of isolated input faults, together with an operational taxonomy of the methods. Across four real-world datasets and eight scored scenarios governed by a standardized severity model, it reports worst-scenario degradation, clean mean squared error (MSE), and worst-scenario fault-time MSE, separating relative robustness from absolute error. Explicit fault-training methods train on adjacent fault families disjoint from the scored scenarios. Empirically, forecasting architectures favored by clean MSE

translated_title: 预测任务中传感器故障鲁棒性的基准测试
translated_abstract: 信息物理系统（CPS）预测模型依赖于可能存在噪声、偏差、缺失或时间错位的传感器数据流，然而标准的预测评估通常仅凭名义误差来选择模型，而未展示这些模型在此类故障下是否仍然保持鲁棒。我们提出SensorFault-Bench，这是一个以CPS为基础的评估协议，通过对孤立输入故障进行受控的合成压力测试来评估各类预测架构和鲁棒性改进方法，并提供了一套方法的操作性分类体系。该基准涵盖四个真实世界数据集和八个由标准化严重程度模型控制的评分场景，报告最坏场景下的性能退化、干净数据下的均方误差（MSE）以及最坏场景下故障发生时的MSE，从而将相对鲁棒性与绝对误差区分开来。显式故障训练方法在与评分场景不相交的相邻故障族上进行训练。实证结果表明，在干净MSE上表现更优的预测架构……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了SensorFault-Bench，一个面向信息物理系统的传感器故障鲁棒性基准，通过受控合成压力测试在四个真实数据集和八个标准化评分场景下评估预测模型对孤立输入故障的鲁棒性，并将相对鲁棒性与绝对误差区分开来。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SensorFault-Bench, a CPS-grounded benchmark that evaluates forecasting models' robustness to isolated sensor faults through controlled synthetic stress tests across four real-world datasets and eight standardized scored scenarios, separating relative robustness from absolute error.
